entities.name: Luis de Carvajal y de la Cueva
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Luis de Carvajal was governor of the Spanish province of Nuevo León in present-day Mexico, slave dealer, and the first Spanish subject known to have entered Texas from Mexico across the lower Rio Grande.
